reason: The target repository already contains a valid user-created agent with an 8-hex agent ID and no provider_id/model_id. Strictly requiring new-format IDs and bound models would hide it from the requested agent inventory. Keep the record visible and chat-capable without rewriting its stored JSON.
required_invalidations: Add AC06 compatibility work item between AC02 and AC03.
Invalidate the current AC03 claim until it consumes the revised contract and AC06 handoff.
Review legacy-record inventory, null provider/model rendering and request-scoped model fallback against the actual record.
decision: Accepted by project inspection and user instruction to continue; no stored legacy agent file is migrated or rewritten.
